text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed KV/prefix cache hit-rate dropped from ~0.92 to ~0.55 over the last hour for prod. Where's the canonical dashboard/panels to triage this and who owns the alert? Need quick next steps.

dan: Grafana: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/kv-prefix-cache — panels to check: 'Prefix cache hit rate (by prefix)', 'Cache hit/miss rates', 'Top miss prefixes'. Metric names: `redwood_cache_hit_total` and `redwood_cache_lookup_total` (use rate over 5m). Example PromQL:```sum(rate(redwood_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_cache_lookup_total[5m]))``` Also `redwood_cache_hit_ratio{prefix=~".*"}` for per-prefix. Owner is eng-platform oncall (rotation page in the dashboard header).

priya: For logs, use Loki query: `{app="kv-cache"} |= "lookup" | json | prefix="${prefix}"` then filter `status=MISS`. Dash link: https://loki.internal.redwood/explore?query=%7Bapp%3D%22kv-cache%22%7D%20%7C%3D%20%22MISS%22

cachebot: Alert triggered: KV_PREFIX_CACHE_HITRATE_LOW (fired) — value=0.55 (<0.6) for 12m. Alert runbook: https://confluence.internal.redwood/kv-cache/runbook — suggested action: confirm whether it's an actual workload change vs. eviction storm.

alex: Two quick triage ideas: 1) Check top keys by misses (panel in grafana) to see if a single prefix spiked; 2) Check eviction rate (`redwood_cache_evictions_total`) — if high, probably sizing or churn. If this is noisy, we should group alerts by prefix and raise threshold per-prefix.

maria: OK I'll check top-miss prefixes now. If it's a single noisy prefix we can temporary flush or pin. Any quick command to flush a prefix?

dan: flush CLI:```infra cache flush --type kv --prefix "org_12345_"``` or via console: KV Cache -> Prefix Actions -> Flush. Note: flushing will increase backend load while warms back up.

priya: Also check per-model request rate — if a rollout caused a fanout to many cold prefixes that can drop the hit-rate. Query: `sum(rate(requests_total{model=~".*"}[1m])) by (model)`

alex: If alert noise continues, propose: change alert from global ratio to `for: 15m`, add `sum by(prefix) (...) < 0.5` and silence low-traffic prefixes (requests < 50/min). I'll open a small alert-tuning PR.

maria: Thanks — I'll open a ticket and assign to @dan oncall, run a targeted flush for the top 2 prefixes, and post results here in 10m.

dan: Ping me when you open the ticket and I can run the flush and watch load. Also adding a Grafana panel to show 95th percentile per-prefix heatmap could help long-term. :thumbsup:
